images.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent staff portrait for a cheerful mobile cooking game set at a Lagos mama put roadside food spot.
Subject: Chidi, a cheerful young Nigerian apprentice server in his late teens, warm brown skin, teal-and-gold ankara shirt, white apron, holding a plain white ceramic plate with a thin cream rim filled with jollof rice. Head-and-shoulders portrait including his hands and plate.
Style: stylised 3D cartoon render, soft and chunky like modern casual mobile games, clay/Pixar-like, friendly face, not photoreal. Saturated appetising colours, simple clear silhouette readable at 56 pixels.
Composition: one character centred, filling about 80% of the square frame, three-quarter front view. Keep entire head, shoulders, hands and plate inside frame with clear transparent padding.
Lighting: soft warm studio light from top-left.
Output: square 1024x1024 PNG, fully transparent background with real alpha.
Constraints: no text, numbers, logos, brand names, number plates, real people, scenery, table or extra props.
images.export: Alpha preserved; subject scaled to approximately 80% extent; WebP quality 88.
